news.title: Tata Capital Q2 net profit rises 51% on higher income
news.summary: Tata Capital’s second-quarter net profit rose 51% year-on-year to Rs 1,660 crore, supported by higher interest income and loan growth. Assets under management increased 26% to Rs 3.08 lakh crore, while floating-rate lending adjustments and margin improvement remain key priorities.

news.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
news.summary: Sensex and Nifty closed marginally lower as elevated crude oil prices and Fed uncertainty tempered sentiment. Smallcaps surged over 2%, midcaps gained over 1%, and market breadth favoured bulls, with 2,455 NSE stocks advancing.

news.title: Waaree Energies Q2 Results: Profit falls 15% YoY to Rs 719 crore, revenue rises 24%
news.summary: Waaree Energies reported a 14.7% year-on-year profit decline to Rs 718.68 crore in Q2FY27, despite 23.9% revenue growth. Margin pressure persisted as the company acquired data centre subsidiaries, exploring diversification into AI and digital infrastructure.

news.title: OneSource Specialty Pharma shares jump 14% after Q2 results; recover 50% from recent lows
news.summary: OneSource Specialty Pharma shares rose nearly 14% after the company reported Q2 revenue growth of 37% year-on-year and adjusted profit after tax of ₹93.7 crore. The company maintained its FY28 targets and expects expanded drug-device combination capacity to support future growth.
